title: Yellowed Roasted British Cod Roast
description: A delicious and flaky cod roast dish, featuring cold water cod and an ayurvedic-sattvic friendly cure, perfect for a solo dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the sea salt, brown sugar, black pepper, and garlic powder.
Place the cod fillet in a shallow dish and sprinkle the cure mixture evenly over both sides of the fish.
Drizzle the lemon juice and olive oil over the cod fillet.
Let the cod fillet sit at room temperature for 15 minutes to allow the cure to set.
Place the cod fillet on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and roast in the preheated oven for 12 minutes.
Remove the cod fillet from the oven and sprinkle the chopped parsley over the top.
Return the cod fillet to the oven and continue to roast for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
